scope: Observed qualification clock semantics only; native server deadlines and numerical criteria unchanged.
finding: Apple POSIX MONOTONIC derives from wall time minus boot time; Python runtime uses mach_absolute_time. Sleep contributes differently. Prior wall-clock and monitor elapsed durations must not be treated as identical or used for a speedup claim. New qualification controllers hold temporary caffeinate -i leases to prevent automatic idle sleep; no persistent power settings changed.
